leakage_rule: A forecast is eligible only when its numeric model snapshot was frozen before the compared book quote. No refit, player removal, threshold selection, or metric change after outcomes.
identity_rule: Exact sport, event, player, market type, side and line only. No loose player matching. Duplicate retries are removed by quote_id; the last eligible pre-kick quote is the close.

continuous_player_props.eligibility: NFL regular-season pregame rows with an exact frozen model prediction, an audited FanDuel quote, a final official result and no void/push unless the metric explicitly retains pushes.
continuous_player_props.primary_comparison: Paired absolute error: abs(model median - result) minus abs(FanDuel closing line - result). Negative favors the model.
secondary: directional over/under record at the captured price
closing-line movement after the frozen signal
continuous_player_props.inference: Paired game-cluster bootstrap 95% interval. Player rows in one game are not treated as independent games.

anytime_touchdown.eligibility: Exact RB/WR/TE NFL pregame rows with a frozen model probability, audited FanDuel quote and settled binary result.
primary_comparison: Brier score model minus book benchmark
log loss model minus book benchmark
anytime_touchdown.book_benchmark: Use no-vig probability only when both sides needed to remove vig were captured. If only Yes is available, raw implied probability is reported as a vigged benchmark and cannot establish betting edge.

gates.week_1: Always descriptive. One week cannot establish an edge, regardless of the point estimate.
gates.predictive_signal: After at least 100 settled NFL games and 500 exact player-market outcomes, both registered primary deltas for a market family must favor the model and their paired game-bootstrap 95% upper bounds must be below zero.
gates.betting_edge: Predictive signal plus prospective positive closing-line value after vig and a positive lower 95% bound for net return on pre-registered recommendations. Until then, no edge label and no model-price difference in the UI.
gates.failed_or_unsettled: If either primary metric loses or either interval crosses zero, label the result weak/unsettled and continue measurement without tuning on the test set.

reporting: eligible and excluded counts with reasons
calibration by market and probability bucket
CLV and net units only for genuinely prospective recommendations
known_limits: Week 1 is a thin, high-roster-uncertainty sample.
Current matchup features are descriptive and are not used to move numeric player projections.
A vigged one-sided implied probability is not a fair-probability benchmark.
No result may be promoted from research to picks by looking only at favorable subgroups after the fact.
